skill_name: Explain the advantages the of using a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN).
workflow: The main advantage of using a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) over other types of neural networks is its ability to capture patterns in data, such as images or video scenes, which can be very difficult for a regular neural network. By utilizing convolutional layers, which extract features from the input data, a CNN can achieve better accuracy in certain tasks such as image or video recognition, or object detection. Additionally, CNNs are able to capture spatial relationships in data, as well
